stereotypeDefinition.comment: Classifies custom (non-generated) files under a folder or project by classification and severity, scoped by a glob. Multiple items can be added to the `Entries` property to classify different subsets of its custom files; where more than one item's glob matches a file, the last matching item wins, so place broad catch-all entries first and exceptions below them. Only ever consulted for files with no output-log entry - generated files are classified via their template's Output Classification instead.
stereotypeDefinition.name: Custom File Classification
